# Stormcage

> Cross-agent context and memory firewall enforcing semantic taint tracking, NFKC normalization, and OWASP LLM01 prompt injection defense.

## Core Capabilities
- Semantic Provenance Taint Tracking: Labels context fragments with `TRUST_LOCAL_WORKSPACE`, `TAINT_EXTERNAL_USER`, or `TAINT_UNTRUSTED_WEB`.
- NFKC Unicode Decomposition: Neutralizes homoglyph cloaking and strips invisible zero-width characters.
- Multi-Tier Injection Detection: Evaluates text against OWASP LLM01 signatures and semantic intent-drift models.
- SHA-256 Verdict Caching: Delivers sub-0.5ms evaluation speeds across shared agent scratchpads.
- Context Quarantine: Blocks contaminated memories from reaching execution-tier agents.

## CLI Usage
- `stormcage scan --input "<text>"`: Evaluates arbitrary text for prompt injection risks.
- `stormcage filter --file <path>`: Strips dangerous Unicode and normalizes file content.
- `stormcage server --port 8181`: Runs background memory firewall API server.

## Key Addresses & Paths
- HTTP API: `http://127.0.0.1:8181`
- Documentation: README.md & AGENTS.md
